summaries.Good news: Today's uplifting stories celebrate human connection and animal rescue—a pilot daughter flying alongside her captain father while her mother works the cabin crew, and a sloth bear thriving after escape from forced dancing in India.
summaries.Ideas: The discourse spans AI safety concerns with multiple industry leaders raising alarms about their own companies, and practical wisdom on managing expectations and visibility in career development.
summaries.Technology: Innovation highlights include Google's playful reimagining of keyboard interaction with moving keys, MIT's disaster-zone drone navigation, Swiss soft robotics fiber motors, and next-generation hopping robots inspired by fleas.
summaries.Design: Today's selection showcases architecture's poetic restraint with a monolithic concrete home inspired by rock-cut monks, bold material choices like corrugated red extensions, and clever compact space optimization—all demonstrating design thinking applied to lived experience.

items.title: Google Japan puts 116 keys on conveyor belts because typing was too easy

items.title: Minuscule Swiss fiber motor keeps robots squishy and pliable
items.snippet: If you've already designed a soft-bodied robot, it kind of defeats the purpose if you just go and stick a rigid motor inside of it. items.line: Creating a flexible fiber motor solves the paradox of soft robotics—enabling actuators that don't compromise the fundamental properties of compliant systems.
